name: enso ex Installer
description: Untethered jailbreak and CFW loader for PlayStation Vita/TV units on firmware 3.65.
long_description:
Untethered jailbreak and CFW loader for PlayStation Vita/TV units on firmware 3.65
Features:
 - Custom kernel loader
 - Support for unsigned base kernel modules
 - Code execution on the bootloader level
 - SD2VITA and EMMC -based recovery
 - Various tweaks such as custom bootlogo or DevKit VitaTV mode support
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
